engagement_background.objective: Generate $0.54–$1.2 million in annual savings through strategic sourcing across key spend areas, while establishing a best-in-class, enterprise-wide procurement process that leverages Choice Health At Home’s scale and supports value creation goals before July 2024.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Initial scope covers 12 indirect spend categories (Fleet, Employee Benefits, Medical Supplies, Pharmacy, Medical Equipment, Temp Labor – Therapists & Nurses, Telecom, Commercial Print, Copiers/MFPs, Office Supplies, IT Hardware) representing $17.7 million in AP spend, of which 75-90 % is considered addressable. Tail spend within each category and additional items (e.g., Assisted Living, Doctors, Hospice Services) are currently out of scope or on hold and may be revisited later.
constraints_challenges: Supplier non-responsiveness to line-item data requests, delaying baseline creation.
Decentralized stakeholder base – requires coordination across multiple locations and functions for data, interviews and approvals.
Incumbent supplier sensitivities and risk of ‘side conversations’, necessitating a unified communication strategy.
Incomplete internal usage and contract data; need to source detail directly from vendors to build accurate baselines.
Aggressive five-to-six-month timeline with target completion by July 2024.
Potential stakeholder fatigue or pushback if savings are not realized quickly.

procurement_environment.data_availability: Accounts-payable spend extract (~$39 M) available; limited centralized contract files; detailed usage data must be collected from high-spend suppliers.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Duplicate vendor names and unmapped GL codes required cleansing; significant gaps in historical usage and contract data for several suppliers.
